name: Trance
overview: The Bible presents trance as a state in which individuals receive divine revelation or experience God's presence, often while remaining conscious. Balaam's trance, described in Numbers 24:4 and 24:16, involves seeing visions of the Almighty with his eyes open, indicating a supernatural encounter with God's truth. Similarly, Peter and Paul experienced trances during pivotal moments of prayer and revelation in Acts 10:10 and Acts 22:17, underscoring trance as a means through which God communicates His will and guidance to His servants.
